## Clima-Tact

Fight with the Art of Weather and carry a Clima-Tact.

## Sorcery Clima-Tact

The Sorcery Clima-Tact combines Weatheria's science with Usopp's tinkering. Later Nami added a thundercloud with a mind of its own.

Carry a Sorcery Clima-Tact, unlock Thunder Lance Tempo and reach 30,000 Doriki.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Thunderbolt Tempo](st_art_of_weather.md#q-2bf376b26159b724)

**Tasks**

- Carry a Sorcery Clima-Tact
- Unlock Thunder Lance Tempo
- Reach 30,000 Doriki

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +60,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +12 Training Points (your style)
